body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.

Tonight was orientation, not a normal night. You helped build the rules of this room yourself. From here on, every session runs the same way: warm up, play three games, cool down, a short lesson, then this phone for a few minutes, then cleanup.
What you are here to learn
The room ranked these together tonight. By the end of the program you will be able to do all five.
Three ways to tap, and any one of them ends it right away.
The instant your partner taps, you stop. Not after you finish your move. Stop right away, every time.
